summary: Frontend-only testing of the two new /editor features: Export-all-drafts ZIP and hover-preview on draft cards. All acceptance criteria pass. Empty-state hides the export button. Saving 3 drafts (including a weird 'My / weird : name!!') then clicking [data-testid=drafts-export-all] triggers a download named photoedit-drafts-YYYY-MM-DD.zip (regex matched). The ZIP contains exactly 3 .jpg entries + drafts-manifest.txt; slashes/colons in the weird name are sanitised (My-_-weird-_-name_.jpg — no '/' or ':' present). Hover on each draft-card shows [data-testid=draft-hover-preview] with correct [data-testid=draft-hover-name] matching the card's name (verified on 2 cards). Computed style on .draft-hover-preview .hover-preview-image: height=200px, position=static (NOT absolute) — confirms the CSS-collision with Home page's .preview-image is resolved. Mouse-leave hides preview. Regression: load/rename/delete drafts, /ads.txt (200), all 7 routes (/, /about, /contact, /privacy, /terms, /disclaimer, /editor) return 200.
critical_code_review_comments: Editor.jsx is 918 lines — recommend splitting drafts panel, hover-preview, and export-zip logic into dedicated components/hooks for maintainability.

exportAllDrafts assumes item.data always contains a comma-separated data-URL; if item.data ever became empty the split would still succeed but push undefined base64 into zip.file. Add a guard 'if (!b64) continue;' for defensive robustness.
showHover captures rect.left as 'right' — semantic naming mismatch (works today because the preview is CSS-positioned but confusing). Consider renaming state field.
seed_data_creation: localStorage cleared before test; created 3 drafts ('Alpha One', 'Beta Two', 'My / weird : name!!') then renamed one and deleted one during regression. Final state: 2 drafts remain in localStorage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Drafts tab testid is 'drafts-tab' (NOT 'tab-drafts'). Save-draft prompt uses window.prompt titled 'Name this draft' — attach dialog handler via page.once('dialog', ...) BEFORE clicking drafts-save-current. Rename also uses window.prompt. Download capture pattern: async with page.expect_download() as info: click; dl = await info.value; then dl.save_as(path). ZIP entries verified: image basenames are safeFileName(item.name) via /[^\w\-. ]+/g -> _ then spaces -> -. Hover preview uses hover-preview-image / -meta / -name / -sub class names that no longer collide with Home's .preview-image.
rca of the issue: n/a — no issues found; all new features functional.
